text:
I’ll inspect the repository structure and the main page, metadata, sitemap, robots, and structured-data surfaces, then report prioritized SEO/GEO issues with exact file and line references.

## Audit findings

| Severity | File / lines | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| 🔴 High | `robots.txt:5-6` | `GPTBot` is blocked from the entire site, preventing ChatGPT search visibility. This conflicts with `geo.config.json:1`, which says AI search crawlers are allowed. | Remove the `GPTBot` block if AI discovery is desired. Define explicit policies for other relevant crawlers only if intentionally supported. |
| 🔴 High | `index.html:6-10`, `breads.html:6-10`, `classes.html:6-10` | No Schema.org structured data. Search engines and AI systems receive no machine-readable bakery, product, course, address, hours, or breadcrumb information. | Add JSON-LD for `Bakery`/`LocalBusiness`, `Product` or `ItemList`, `Course`/`Event`, and `BreadcrumbList`. |
| 🔴 High | `index.html:14-17` | The homepage provides no physical address, phone number, opening hours, booking/pre-order URL, or service-area detail. “York” alone is weak local SEO information. | Add complete NAP data, opening hours, collection address, contact details, service area, and a real pre-order link. Keep it consistent with LocalBusiness schema. |
| 🟠 Medium | `classes.html:14-15` | The classes page is too vague for queries such as price, dates, duration, location, capacity, and booking. It has no booking link. | Add class dates, price, duration, venue, instructor, availability, cancellation terms, FAQs, and a clear booking CTA. Add Course/Event schema. |
| 🟠 Medium | `breads.html:14-16` | “Over twenty loaves” is not an indexable product catalogue. There are no individual bread names beyond two examples, prices, sizes, ingredients, availability, or collection days. | Use structured headings/cards for each bread with name, description, price, ingredients, allergens, availability, and ordering details. Add Product/ItemList schema. |
| 🟠 Medium | `index.html:16` | `/img/loaves.jpg` is referenced, but no image asset exists in the repository. This likely produces a broken image and removes an image-search opportunity. | Add the image at the referenced path or correct the URL; provide responsive dimensions, an optimized format, and descriptive alt text. |
| 🟡 Medium | `breads.html:16` | `data-nosnippet` hides the only allergen-related factual content from search snippets. It also says only “Ask us,” which is not useful answer-ready information. | Remove `data-nosnippet` unless there is a specific legal reason, and publish complete allergen information directly on the page. |
| 🟡 Medium | `index.html:14-17`, `breads.html:14-16`, `classes.html:14-15` | Content is not sufficiently answerable for AI search: it lacks concise facts about products, prices, hours, location, ordering, and classes. | Add factual, self-contained sections and FAQ content that directly answer likely user questions. |
| 🟡 Low | `index.html:10`, `breads.html:10`, `classes.html:10` | No Open Graph or Twitter metadata. This does not directly block indexing, but it weakens link previews and social distribution. | Add `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:image`, `og:type`, and Twitter card metadata. |
| 🟡 Low | `members/index.html:8-9`, `robots.txt:3` | The members page is both `noindex` and disallowed in `robots.txt`. Crawlers cannot fetch it to observe the `noindex` directive, so previously indexed URLs may remain indexed. | If removal from search is required, allow crawling and retain `noindex`; otherwise use authentication or a deliberate exclusion strategy. |
| ⚪ Low | `index.html:2`, `classes.html:2`, `breads.html:2` | The site is in York/UK but uses generic `lang="en"` rather than `en-GB`. | Use `lang="en-GB"` if the audience and content are UK-specific. |

## Already present

Titles, meta descriptions, canonical URLs, mobile viewport tags, internal navigation, a sitemap, and exclusion of the private members area are present. `sitemap.xml:3-5` correctly contains the three public pages; it should be updated whenever new indexable product, class, location, or FAQ pages are added.
